name: Ghotok
what: Bangladeshi home-tutor agencies (tuition media) use it to run every guardian request, applicant, demo class and media fee from first call to paid.
hard_part: The media-fee ledger is the product: fee and refund rules are agency settings frozen onto each match at confirm, and one shared fixture file of ledger cases must pass in both the Go server tests and the Flutter app tests. The app is local-first with an outbox, so offline settlements show as 'not sent yet' and flush on reconnect.
demo_note: one-tap owner demo on the home page opens the app in the browser; demo data reseeds nightly
facts: 14-state tuition lifecycle mapped from published agency terms
50 Flutter tests plus go test and go vet passing
Owner app runs as Android APK and as a Flutter web build
Duplicate bKash TrxIDs caught before a payment is saved
